_comment: Classic MVP wilds -- simple linked rooms, no America atlas.

rooms.title: Wild Country - Forest Trail
rooms.description: A packed dirt trail winds between oaks and scrub. Millbrook's walls lie east; deeper forest waits west and north.

rooms.title: Wild Country - Rocky Knoll
rooms.description: Weathered granite breaks through thin soil. You can see crows wheeling over the treeline.

rooms.title: Wild Country - Creek Bed
rooms.description: A shallow creek cuts through mossy stones. Tracks in the mud might be deer -- or something hungrier.

rooms.title: Wild Country - Wolf Run
rooms.description: Torn fur snags on brambles. A lean wolf watches from the shadows if you linger.

rooms.title: Wild Country - Goblin Camp
rooms.description: A crude fire pit and stolen crates mark a goblin camp. Green ears twitch at every snapped twig.

rooms.title: Wild Country - Pine Stand
rooms.description: Tall pines choke the light. The wind sounds like distant howling.

rooms.title: Wild Country - Old Road
rooms.description: Cobbles peek through grass on a forgotten imperial road. Millbrook traders rarely come this far.

rooms.title: Wild Country - Meadow Edge
rooms.description: Wildflowers give way to open meadow. Good camping, if the wolves agree.

rooms.title: Wild Country - Hunter's Rest
rooms.description: A ring of cold ash and a broken arrow shaft. Someone rested here recently.
